general_info.subject: RFQ for global launch marketing services for new kids health drink

rfq_draft.scope_overview: Select an integrated agency partner for the global launch of a new kids health drink covering strategy, creative, TVC development and production, paid and organic social, claims compliance review, and launch governance.

buyer_priorities.title: Kids advertising compliance
buyer_priorities.description: The program must be safe for child-directed marketing and claims usage.

buyer_priorities.title: Launch speed
buyer_priorities.description: The buyer values partners who can manage approvals and hit the launch calendar.

buyer_priorities.title: Integrated delivery
buyer_priorities.description: The buyer prefers partners who can coordinate multiple launch workstreams cleanly.

mandatory_conditions: Vendors must explicitly confirm capability to support child-directed advertising compliance for this launch.
Vendors must explicitly confirm capability to support product claims review for launch assets and product-related claims.

line_items.description: Launch strategy, audience segmentation, messaging framework, creative territory development and master campaign toolkit for a new kids health drink.
Development of flagship TV commercial concept and all pre-production creative required for global launch approvals.
End-to-end TVC shoot, post-production and delivery of master film and cutdowns for paid media use.
Organic social content strategy, monthly content calendar and asset adaptation for Meta, YouTube and TikTok.
Paid social and video media planning across Meta, YouTube and TikTok for global launch period.
Campaign trafficking, paid media activation, optimization and performance reporting across Meta, YouTube and TikTok.
Legal and regulatory review of kids advertising content and product-related claims across launch assets and scripts.
Program management, stakeholder coordination, asset trafficking and master launch governance across all workstreams.

sections.title: Mandatory gates
sections.description: Pass/fail eligibility checks for critical compliance capabilities.

sections.title: Technical evaluation
sections.description: Assessment of launch delivery quality, integration, and solution strength.

sections.title: Commercial evaluation
sections.description: Structured pricing submission and quote completeness review.

criteria.title: Child marketing compliance
criteria.description: Confirm capability to support child-directed advertising compliance for the launch.

evidence_checks.label: Compliance capability confirmation
evidence_checks.description: Check that the bidder explicitly confirms a delivery route for child-directed advertising compliance support.

vendor_question.text: Select one option for your capability to support child-directed advertising compliance across launch assets and approvals: (a) Yes - delivered by our organisation, (b) Yes - delivered through a named specialist partner, or (c) No. If you select (b), provide the partner name.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the explicit mandatory confirmation for child-directed advertising compliance capability.

deterministic_scoring.answer_format: Single discrete selection with partner name required only if partner route is selected.
deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass if the bidder confirms capability directly or through a named specialist partner; fail otherwise.

rules.condition: Response is 'Yes - delivered by our organisation'.
Response is 'Yes - delivered through a named specialist partner' and a partner name is provided.
Response is 'No', blank, or selects partner delivery without naming the partner.

criteria.title: Claims review capability
criteria.description: Confirm capability to support product claims review for launch assets and approvals.

evidence_checks.label: Claims review confirmation
evidence_checks.description: Check that the bidder explicitly confirms a delivery route for product claims review support.

vendor_question.text: Select one option for your capability to support product claims review for launch assets and related approvals: (a) Yes - delivered by our organisation, (b) Yes - delivered through a named specialist partner, or (c) No. If you select (b), provide the partner name.
vendor_question.purpose: Tests the explicit mandatory confirmation for product claims review capability.

deterministic_scoring.answer_format: Single discrete selection with partner name required only if partner route is selected.
deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass if the bidder confirms capability directly or through a named specialist partner; fail otherwise.

rules.condition: Response is 'Yes - delivered by our organisation'.
Response is 'Yes - delivered through a named specialist partner' and a partner name is provided.
Response is 'No', blank, or selects partner delivery without naming the partner.

criteria.title: Launch governance and speed
criteria.description: Quality of the proposed governance, approvals, and timeline protection approach.

evidence_checks.label: Launch plan evidence
evidence_checks.description: Check for a concrete launch plan covering milestones, approval flow, critical path, and escalation.

vendor_question.text: Provide your proposed launch governance and approval-management plan for this scope, including key milestones, critical path, approval routing, escalation approach, and the actions you will take to protect the stated launch calendar.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the bidder's ability to manage approvals and maintain launch speed.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score highly where the response gives a realistic end-to-end plan across the requested workstreams, clear milestones and approval gates, identifiable owners and dependencies, practical escalation paths, and credible mitigations for timeline risk. Score weakly where the plan is generic, misses approval complexity, lacks critical-path thinking, or relies on optimistic sequencing without mitigation.

criteria.title: Integrated delivery model
criteria.description: Strength of the operating model for coordinating all launch workstreams.

evidence_checks.label: Operating model evidence
evidence_checks.description: Check for a clear integrated operating model spanning all requested service areas and governance interfaces.

vendor_question.text: Describe the operating model you will use to coordinate strategy, creative, TVC development and production, organic social, paid media planning and buying, compliance review, and launch program management as one integrated launch program.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the bidder's ability to coordinate multiple launch workstreams cleanly.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score highly where the response shows one coherent delivery model with clear accountability, role clarity, handoffs, cross-workstream coordination, integration of compliance review into delivery, and efficient stakeholder management. Score weakly where execution appears siloed, interfaces are unclear, scope coverage is incomplete, or the client would need to coordinate major dependencies.

criteria.title: Campaign solution quality
criteria.description: Coherence and completeness of the proposed launch solution across strategy, creative, TVC, and social/media channels.

evidence_checks.label: Campaign approach evidence
evidence_checks.description: Check for a joined-up launch approach across strategy, creative development, TVC, social, and paid media.

vendor_question.text: Describe your proposed global launch solution across strategy, messaging, creative territory, TVC, organic social, and paid social/video, showing how the workstreams connect into one launch campaign.
vendor_question.purpose: Assesses the strength and coherence of the bidder's proposed launch approach.

criteria.qualitative_scoring_guidance: Score highly where the response presents a coherent launch idea with clear strategic logic, strong message and creative linkage, practical adaptation across TVC and social channels, and alignment between organic and paid activation. Score weakly where channel plans feel disconnected, the strategic rationale is thin, or the proposed outputs do not form a consistent launch campaign.

criteria.title: Pricing completeness
criteria.description: Check that the commercial submission fully covers the requested lots in a structured format.

evidence_checks.label: Completed pricing schedule
evidence_checks.description: Check that all requested line items are addressed with quote status, pricing fields, and exclusions or assumptions.

deterministic_scoring.summary: Pass if the pricing schedule is complete and usable for evaluation; fail if key commercial fields are missing.

rules.condition: All requested line items are present in the pricing schedule and each row includes quote status, currency, total price when priced, and exclusions or assumptions.
Any requested line item is missing, or pricing status/price/currency/exclusions data is materially incomplete for evaluation.

questions.purpose: Tests the explicit mandatory confirmation for child-directed advertising compliance capability.

columns.label: Exclusions or assumptions
columns.description: State exclusions, dependencies, or assumptions affecting the quote.

generation_rationale: The two buyer-entered mandatory conditions were preserved as separate MAC gates because they concern child-directed advertising compliance and product claims review, both of which are critical compliance capabilities for this scope.

Launch speed was translated into a cutoff-backed technical criterion rather than a MAC, because delivery readiness is better judged on the strength and credibility of the proposed governance and approval plan than by a simple yes/no confirmation.

Integrated delivery and campaign solution quality were separated to avoid overlap: one assesses the operating model across workstreams, while the other assesses the coherence of the proposed launch work itself.

Technical scored and cutoff-backed criteria total 100 points, and the aggregate technical threshold is set at 60 to reflect a moderate services procurement risk profile once the compliance gates are passed.
